descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
The party is in full swing - dancers on the disco floor, a band in the garage, karaoke in the basement bar. You walk in with a weapon in each hand. What happens next is up to you.

A WHOLE HOUSE OF PARTY
Five zones joined by stairs and doors: the main floor with its light-up dance floor, upstairs bedrooms and a home cinema, a basement bar with karaoke and a pool table, a backyard pool party with a bouncy castle, and a garage with a live band.

A WEAPON WHEEL IN EACH HAND
Revolver, shotgun, rifle, sniper rifle, baseball bat, axe, hockey stick and knife. Press B for the right-hand wheel and Y for the left, and mix any two. Swing for real - bats and blades land with weight.

THE GUESTS FIGHT BACK
One loud noise wakes the whole house. Brawlers grab a bat and charge, gunners fire slow glowing rounds you can see and dodge, and cowards run and hide until they come back angry.

IT NEVER STOPS
Clear a room and a new crowd barges in. Walk into any room and the party starts over. Bright cartoon style, a soundtrack of party anthems, and no player death - just keep the mayhem going.

Controls: left stick to move, right stick to turn, B / Y for the weapon wheels, trigger to fire, swing to hit.
